Name: Pickaxe Digspots
Author: megmom84
Description:
10/07/18

Just changed the update keys because I was told they work better this way. If you don't want to redownload the mod, you don't have to.


9/4/18

I made this into a content patcher pack but I guess I forgot to upload it here. Anyway, this version requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=description]Content Patcher[/url]﻿. I also added update keys. Shouldn't conflict with your other Cursors.xnb-changing mods.

___________________________________________________________________________________________--

I didn't like any of the options out there to replace digspots (though they are all good) and wanted something a little more "dig" related. I had fun with this.

Not compatible with any mods that change the Cursors.xnb file. For example, Starry Sky Interface and other interface changing mods. Recommend you back up your original file or use XNBLoader instead, to preserve your originals. Have fun digging!

Downloads.Description: Apparently the update keys work better this way. No other changes were made, if you don't want to redownload the mod.
